mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) id,c.name,c.description,(SELECT real_name FROM app_user WHERE id=c.teacher_id) teacherName,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_enrollment e WHERE e.course_id=c.id) studentCount,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id=q.chapter_id WHERE ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.is_current=1) questionCount FROM course c WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY c.sort_order,c.id
SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) id,c.name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.chapter_id=c.id) questionCount FROM chapter c WHERE c.course_id=#{courseId} AND c.is_current=1 ORDER BY c.sort_order,c.id

SELECT CAST(k.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(k.chapter_id AS CHAR) chapterId,k.name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_knowledge qk WHERE qk.knowledge_id=k.id) questionCount FROM knowledge_point k JOIN chapter c ON c.id=k.chapter_id WHERE c.course_id=#{courseId} AND c.is_current=1 AND c.id=#{chapterId} ORDER BY c.sort_order,k.sort_order,k.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND course_id=#{courseId} AND is_current=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_point k JOIN chapter c ON c.id=k.chapter_id WHERE k.id=#{knowledgeId} AND c.course_id=#{courseId} AND c.is_current=1 AND c.id=#{chapterId}
SELECT id FROM course WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(c.id AS CHAR) courseId,c.name courseName, u.real_name teacherName,s.weekday,s.period,s.location FROM course_schedule s JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id=c.teacher_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY s.weekday,s.period,s.id
